name: Ammi
facts: Ammi tried keys on a ring to open the locked attic door
Ammi found the attic dark, stinking, and could see something dark in the corner
Ammi screamed upon seeing the thing in the attic
Ammi felt himself brushed by a hateful current of vapour and saw strange colours
Ammi would give no added particulars of what he saw in the attic
Ammi left nothing capable of motion in the attic room and locked it behind him
Ammi heard a thud, a choked-off scream, and dragging and sucking sounds while descending the stairs
Ammi noticed the woodwork of the staircase was faintly luminous
Ammi's horse and buggy ran off in fright while he was on the stairs
Ammi heard a liquid splash he thought came from the well
Ammi picked up a heavy stick in the attic
Ammi encountered the dying, disintegrating remains of Nahum in the kitchen area
Ammi asked Nahum what it was and received a final dying answer
Ammi laid a red checked tablecloth over what was left of Nahum
Ammi fled through the fields and woods back to his home, avoiding the well
Ammi looked at the well through a window and saw no stone was missing from the rim
Ammi reached his house and found his wife anxious because the horses and buggy had arrived without him
Ammi went to Arkham and notified authorities that the Gardner family was no more
Ammi told the authorities of the deaths of Nahum and Nabby and the disappearance of Merwin and Zenas
Ammi was compelled to lead three officers, the coroner, medical examiner, and veterinary back to the Gardner farm
Ammi feared the fall of night over the farm but was comforted by having others with him

sources.quote: Leaving the harmless babbler on the couch, he took the keys from their nail beside the door and climbed the creaking stairs to the attic.
When he did enter he saw something dark in the corner, and upon seeing it more clearly he screamed outright.
Ammi walked conscious through that low doorway and locked the accursed secret behind him.
Indubitably there was a sort of heavy dragging, and a most detestably sticky noise as of some fiendish and unclean species of suction.
"What was it, Nahum—what was it?" He whispered, and the cleft, bulging lips were just able to crackle out a final answer.
Ammi laid a red checked tablecloth over what was left and reeled out the back door into the fields.
he set out at once for Arkham and notified the authorities that the Gardner family was no more.
Ammi was compelled to take three officers to the Gardner farm, together with the coroner, the medical examiner, and the veterinary who had treated the diseased animals.

name: Nahum
facts: Nahum spoke only clouded, unclear words about the missing Zenas, saying he 'lives in the well'
Nahum was surprised when asked about Nabby, saying 'here she is'
Nahum's dying words described a colour that lived in the well, burned, and sucked the life out of things
Nahum said the colour came in a stone (the meteor) and that a round thing dug out of the stone was smashed by men from the college
Nahum said Thad, Merwin, and Zenas were taken by the thing
Nahum said the thing beats down your mind and gets you, and burns and sucks
Nahum said his head was no good and he didn't know how long since he had fed Nabby
Nahum warned Ammi to look out because the thing would do something more
Nahum was found dying, still alive after a fashion, with his body in collapse, greying, and disintegrating
Nahum's body was brittle and scaling with dry fragments
Nahum completely caved in after speaking his final words
fate: Nahum died, his body rapidly collapsing, greying, and disintegrating into dust after speaking his final words.

sources.quote: "In the well—he lives in the well—" was all that the clouded father would say.
"Nabby? Why, here she is!" was the surprised response of poor Nahum
Everything had happened in the last half-hour, but collapse, greying, and disintegration were already far advanced.

"Nothin' ... nothin' ... the colour ... it burns ... cold an' wet, but it burns ... it lived in the well.... I seen it ... a kind o' smoke ... jest like the flowers last spring ... the well shone at night....
That which spoke could speak no more because it had completely caved in.

name: Zenas
facts: Zenas was missing and Nahum could give no clear data about him
Nahum said Zenas never came back from the well and 'was took'
Nahum said Zenas was a big boy, full of life, and the thing must have gotten strong on him
fate: Zenas disappeared, apparently taken by the thing in the well.

sources.quote: Questioning tactfully, Ammi could get no clear data at all about the missing Zenas.
Zenas never come back from the well ... can't git away ... draws ye
must a' got strong on Zenas ... he was a big boy, full o' life

name: Nabby
facts: Nabby is Nahum's wife, described as mad
Ammi found Nabby, implied to be the shape in the attic corner, sharing the nameless fate of Thaddeus and the livestock
Nahum worried about how long it had been since he fed her and said the thing would get her if they weren't careful
Nahum said her face was getting to have that colour sometimes towards night
fate: Implied to have died in the attic, sharing the fate of the crumbling monstrosity found there.

sources.quote: Then there flashed across the visitor's mind a sudden thought of the mad wife, and he changed his line of inquiry.
the blasphemous monstrosity which confronted him, and which all too clearly had shared the nameless fate of young Thaddeus and the livestock

whar's Nabby, Ammi? ... my head's no good ... dun't know how long sence I fed her ... it'll git her ef we ain't keerful ... jest a colour ... her face is gittin' to hev that colour sometimes towards night

name: Thaddeus
facts: Thaddeus shared the same nameless fate as the monstrosity in the attic and the livestock
Nahum's dying words mentioned Thad among those taken by the colour
fate: Died from the same affliction as the livestock and the thing in the attic.

sources.quote: the blasphemous monstrosity which confronted him, and which all too clearly had shared the nameless fate of young Thaddeus and the livestock
Thad an' Merwin an' Zenas ... everything alive ... suckin' the life out of everything

name: Merwin
facts: Merwin was mentioned by Nahum as one taken along with Thad and Zenas
Ammi reported that Merwin had disappeared
fate: Disappeared, presumed taken by the colour.

sources.quote: Thad an' Merwin an' Zenas ... everything alive ... suckin' the life out of everything
He also stated that Merwin and Zenas had disappeared.

name: The Narrator
facts: The narrator states that Ammi would give him no added particulars of the attic scene
The narrator gathered from Ammi's account that no moving thing was left in the attic room

sources.quote: Ammi would give me no added particulars of this scene, but the shape in the corners does not re-appear in his tale as a moving object.

I gathered that no moving thing was left in that attic room, and that to leave anything capable of motion there would have been a deed so monstrous as to damn any accountable being to eternal torment.

name: the Gardner farm
facts: The farmhouse contained a locked attic room with a small window half-obscured by wooden bars
Most of the house was built before 1700
The farm had a well near which Ammi's horse had been tied
The whole aspect of the farm had a grey desolation
Officers, the coroner, the medical examiner, and the veterinary drove out to the farm and arrived about four o'clock

sources.quote: God! how old the house was! Most of it built before 1700.
The six men drove out in a democrat-wagon, following Ammi's buggy, and arrived at the pest-ridden farmhouse about four o'clock.
The whole aspect of the farm with its grey desolation was terrible enough, but those two crumbling objects were beyond all bounds.
